page.layout: One printed title page, all in the centre column. From top to bottom: a small line "IONAE", the large title "PROPHETAE" over a line "LIBER. CVM" (smaller lines follow), an italic line "ENARRATIONE, RECENS", "tradita in Academia Basileae,", "A", a line with the author's name, a small italic line below it, a central woodcut (engraving) with the library stamp, and the imprint at the foot: "BASILEAE, EX OFFICINA", "nunc Typographia,", and the year.
page.notes: The page is a title page; no running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed. The stamp "Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München" is a library stamp and is left out. The woodcut in the centre is an engraving (a figure with a fish or sea creature) and is not text. The title is printed in large letters, and the upper lines look partly mirrored or ghosted, which suggests show-through from the reverse; the readings marked [?] and the illegible lines (author name, small italic line) could not be read with certainty. The year in the imprint is uncertain. The top of the page has a stain and the foxing is heavy, which makes the small lines hard to read.
